facts.claim: NuQ PostgreSQL is postgres:${PG_MAJOR} with PG_MAJOR=17, pg_cron from the unpinned Debian package postgresql-17-cron, shared_preload_libraries='pg_cron' and cron.database_name='postgres' written into postgresql.conf.sample, and nuq.sql copied to /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/010-nuq.sql.

POSTGRES_DB must remain 'postgres': nuq.sql runs CREATE EXTENSION pg_cron in $POSTGRES_DB, and pg_cron can only be created in cron.database_name='postgres'. Upstream SELF_HOST.md suggests POSTGRES_DB=firecrawl, which conflicts.
facts.verified_by: subagent read; pg_cron database rule from pg_cron documentation, not executed

facts.claim: nuq.sql creates extensions pgcrypto and pg_cron, schema nuq with tables queue_scrape, queue_scrape_backlog, queue_crawl_finished, group_crawl, and 36 pg_cron jobs (15-second lock reapers and group finisher, 5-minute cleaners, nightly REINDEX CONCURRENTLY, hourly job_run_details prune). Group rows expire with ttl default 86400000 ms, so NuQ is not durable result storage.

nuq.sql applies ALTER SYSTEM max_wal_size=16GB, min_wal_size=4GB, checkpoint_timeout=15min, wal_buffers=64MB. On a 64 GB microSD this pre-allocates up to 4 GB of WAL and permits 16 GB; M1 must override WAL sizing in project configuration.
harness.ts reads NUQ_WORKER_COUNT from config (default 5, not set in Compose) and spawns that many nuq-worker children.

With NUQ_WORKER_COUNT=1, the PostgreSQL backend and USE_DB_AUTHENTICATION=false, the harness spawns api, worker (queue-worker), extract-worker, nuq-worker-0, nuq-prefetch-worker and nuq-reconciler: 7 Node processes including the harness. Each child is started via spawn('sh', ['-c', cmd]); whether the sh wrappers stay resident (up to 13 processes) is measured in M1. index-worker is added only when USE_DB_AUTHENTICATION is true.
facts.verified_by: subagent read; process count to be measured in M1

facts.claim: The upstream Playwright service launches Chromium with --no-sandbox --disable-setuid-sandbox --no-zygote and MAX_CONCURRENT_PAGES default 10. The project browser worker must not inherit either (CLAUDE.md section 14).

Root docker-compose.yaml (blob e2ade0104390caf31cdcae04faa619c2674dc693): api and playwright-service built from source; redis:alpine with --bind 0.0.0.0; rabbitmq:3-management; nuq-postgres built from source; foundationdb and foundationdb-init (foundationdb/foundationdb:7.3.63) always start; the API port is published on all interfaces; postgres, redis and rabbitmq have no named volumes; NUQ_WORKER_COUNT is not set.

facts.claim: Core RabbitMQ declarations use durable quorum queues (extract-queue, monitoring queue, nuq prefetch) and one exclusive, auto-delete, non-durable classic reply queue in nuq.ts. None is a transient non-exclusive queue, the queue type RabbitMQ 4.x deprecates.

Reachable Firecrawl Cloud call: POST /admin/integration/{create-user,validate-api-key,rotate-api-key} proxies to https://integrations.firecrawl.dev and is mounted without the BULL_AUTH_KEY guard, so any client of the native API port can make the self-host call Firecrawl Cloud. Other Firecrawl hosts in apps/api/src are defaults or strings not fetched in the selected configuration (FIRECRAWL_DASHBOARD_URL, AGENT_AUTH_RESOURCE_METADATA_URL, OAuth audience api.firecrawl.dev, mcp.firecrawl.dev allow-list, parse.firecrawl.dev label). Search silently falls back to DuckDuckGo when SearXNG is unset or empty. The gateway must never route /admin/* to the native API, and the egress policy must deny *.firecrawl.dev.
facts.verified_by: admin routes read directly; remainder from subagent
